WITH params AS (SELECT 15 AS campaign_id),
campaign AS (
    SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date + 7 AS window_end
    FROM dim_campaign c JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
),
targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = e.campaign_id
),
holdout AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.member_id
    FROM campaign_holdout h
    JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = h.campaign_id
),
members AS (
    SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted
    UNION ALL
    SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
    GROUP BY 1
),
by_group AS (
    SELECT mb.member_group, COUNT(*) AS members, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales
    FROM members mb
    LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT member_group, members, ROUND(mean_net_sales, 2) AS mean_net_sales_per_member
FROM by_group
UNION ALL
SELECT 'uplift (targeted - holdout)', NULL,
       ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'targeted' THEN mean_net_sales END)
           - MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'holdout' THEN mean_net_sales END), 2)
FROM by_group
UNION ALL
SELECT 'check: members in both groups', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted JOIN holdout USING (member_id)), NULL

SELECT s.store_id = 900 AS is_web_store, f.channel_code, w.status, w.login_state,
  CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NULL THEN 'nonmember' ELSE 'member' END AS mem,
  COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net,
  MIN(f.sale_date) AS min_sale, MAX(f.sale_date) AS max_sale,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_dispatch

WITH elig AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM dim_member
  WHERE marketing_consent AND valid_from <= DATE '2025-11-24' AND valid_to >= DATE '2025-11-24' AND join_date <= DATE '2025-11-24'
),
tg AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
ho AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM elig) AS eligible,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM elig WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM tg) AND member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM ho)) AS eligible_in_neither,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tg WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM elig)) AS targeted_not_eligible,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ho WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM elig)) AS holdout_not_eligible,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tg) AS targeted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ho) AS holdout

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS d, s.store_id, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT d, store_id, SUM(net_amount) AS v FROM lines WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07' GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (SELECT business_date AS d, store_id, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07' AND store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT (SELECT SUM(v) FROM mine) AS mine_total, (SELECT SUM(c) FROM ctl) AS control_total,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mine FULL JOIN ctl USING(d, store_id) WHERE ABS(COALESCE(v,0)-COALESCE(c,0))>0.01) AS mismatched_store_days

WITH campaign AS (
    SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end
    FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    WHERE e.campaign_id = 15
),
holdout AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
members AS (
    SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted
    UNION ALL
    SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
    GROUP BY 1
),
by_group AS (
    SELECT mb.member_group, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales
    FROM members mb LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name,
       ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'targeted' THEN mean_net_sales END), 2) AS avg_spend_per_targeted_member,
       ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'holdout' THEN mean_net_sales END), 2) AS avg_spend_per_holdout_member,
       ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'targeted' THEN mean_net_sales END)
           - MAX(CASE WHEN member_group = 'holdout' THEN mean_net_sales END), 2) AS uplift_eur
FROM by_group CROSS JOIN campaign c
GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name
